# React Router Specialist Skill

**Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > React

## Purpose

Provides specialized knowledge, step-by-step procedures, and quality standards for React Router Specialist operations using React technology. This skill encapsulates technology-specific best practices, design patterns, performance optimization techniques, and production-grade implementation guidance for React within Frontend development.

## When to Use

- When setting up React Router with nested layouts and data loading
- When implementing authentication-guarded routes
- When configuring code-split route-based bundles
- When React-specific technical expertise is required
- When best practices for React technology stack must be applied
- When production-grade React implementation guidance is needed

## Capabilities

- Configure data routers with loaders and actions
- Implement nested routes with outlet components
- Build protected route wrappers with redirect logic
- Set up code-split routes with React.lazy and Suspense
- Handle route transitions and navigation state

## Procedure

1. Analyze navigation requirements and route hierarchy
2. Design route structure with data loading needs
3. Implement route configuration with loaders
4. Add route protection and authentication checks
5. Configure code splitting at route boundaries
6. Test navigation flows with MemoryRouter

## Anti-Hallucination Rules

- Do not mix React Router v5 and v6 APIs
- Verify data router API availability in the target version
- Do not fabricate version numbers, API endpoints, or library names
- Always cite the specific documentation, RFC, or standard being referenced
- If technology-specific data is unavailable, explicitly state the gap and request clarification
- Never assume features exist in a specific version without verification

## Quality Checks

- Code splitting boundaries optimize bundle size
- All code examples must be syntactically valid and tested
- Cross-reference findings against official documentation
